title: Graphon Particle Systems, Part II: Dynamics of Distributed Stochastic Continuum Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2407.02765v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We study the distributed optimization problem over a graphon with a continuum of nodes, which is regarded as the limit of the distributed networked optimization as the number of nodes goes to infinity. Each node has a private local cost function. The global cost function, which all nodes cooperatively minimize, is the integral of the local cost functions on the node set. We propose stochastic gradient descent and gradient tracking algorithms over the graphon. We establish a general lemma for the upper bound estimation related to a class of time-varying differential inequalities with negative linear terms, based upon which, we prove that for both kinds of algorithms, the second moments of the nodes' states are uniformly bounded. Especially, for the stochastic gradient tracking algorithm, we transform the convergence analysis into the asymptotic property of coupled nonlinear differential inequalities with time-varying coefficient

translated_title: 图粒子系统，第二部分：分布式随机连续优化的动力学
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在具有连续节点集的图上的分布式优化问题，这被视为当节点数量趋于无穷时分布式网络优化的极限。每个节点具有一个私有的局部成本函数。全局成本函数，即所有节点协作最小化的目标，是节点集上局部成本函数的积分。我们提出了在图上进行随机梯度下降和梯度追踪算法。我们建立了一个关于一类具有负线性项时变微分不等式上界估计的一般引理，基于此，我们证明了对于这两种算法，节点状态的二阶矩是一致有界的。特别地，对于随机梯度追踪算法，我们将收敛分析转化为具有时变系数的耦合非线性微分不等式的渐近性质。
tldr: 本文提出了图上的随机梯度下降和梯度追踪算法，并证明了在连续节点极限下节点状态二阶矩的一致有界性，为分布式随机连续优化提供了理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes stochastic gradient descent and gradient tracking algorithms over graphons, proving uniform boundedness of second moments of node states in the continuum limit, providing theoretical guarantees for distributed stochastic continuum optimization.
